text: hummel is part of THORNICO, a family-owned global conglomerate founded by Thor and Christian Nicholas Stadil, consisting of more than 130 companies worldwide; THORNICO's own about page says the name combination of Thor and Nicholas took its form around the millennium, where father and son secured their investments in hummel.
short: hummel is part of THORNICO, the family-owned conglomerate of Thor and Christian Nicholas Stadil.
